title: 3373. Maximize the Number of Target Nodes After Connecting Trees II

examples.explanation: For i = 0, connect node 0 from the first tree to node 0 from the second tree. For i = 1, connect node 1 from the first tree to node 4 from the second tree. For i = 2, connect node 2 from the first tree to node 7 from the second tree. For i = 3, connect node 3 from the first tree to node 0 from the second tree. For i = 4, connect node 4 from the first tree to node 4 from the second tree.
For every i, connect node i of the first tree with any node of the second tree.
